title: MEOS function type scopes
description: Declared SQL type scopes for MEOS functions whose scope MEOS itself does not state. Consumed by parser/typescope.py, which fails generation on any underivable claimant absent from this file.

types.description: The SQL types the function serves: a list of type names, or "*" when it serves every overload its wrapper declares. An empty list means it serves none of them, which is what a mistagged @csqlfn looks like.

note.description: Why the scope is what it is, and why MEOS does not state it.
